description:
🌎 We are a passionate team from Bolivia participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026!

We are a group of curious, creative, and motivated people interested in technology, science, innovation, and solving real-world problems. We enjoy learning, sharing ideas, and turning challenges into meaningful solutions.

For this challenge, we are excited to explore NASA's Earth observation data, investigate environmental changes, and make science more accessible through technology.

Why join our team?

We believe great ideas come from collaboration, diverse perspectives, and teamwork. We offer a supportive environment where everyone can contribute, learn, experiment, and grow together.

Skills we are looking for:

Data analysis and visualization.

Web development and programming.

UI/UX design and creativity.

Earth science, climate, or environmental knowledge.

Research, storytelling, and presentation skills.

If you are curious, passionate about innovation, and ready to make an impact, we would love to have you on our team! 🚀
